subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & SDK requirements
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acme.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & SDK requirements

Alex / Priya — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from my side + next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Production latency spikes on QPS bursts (current ML infra struggles with short-tail latency)
- Embeddings drift for product taxonomy search; need better reranking to improve SER by ~10-15%
- Need streaming responses and function-calling for our chat playback UI to reduce perceived latency

What we discussed as goals:
- Pilot Redwood in a PoC for the search reranking flow (embeddings -> rerank -> structured output)
- Validate streaming and function-calling for the chat UI under realistic QPS
- Baseline token/unit cost for expected 2M tokens/month and options for dedicated capacity if throughput and predictability are required

Product/Integration notes (high-level):
- SDK changes: SDK supports streaming + function calling. We recommend using the JS/Go SDK for client-side streaming; server-side SDK can handle structured outputs via our JSON schema enforcement.
- Embeddings & reranking: run embeddings (128d) -> lightweight ANN -> Redwood reranking with pairwise scoring. We can provide a tuned reranking profile for product taxonomies.
- Structured outputs: function-calling to extract normalized entities (product_id, category, confidence) and return compact JSON; we’ll share schema examples.

Action items / next steps:
1) Redwood: share SDK quickstart + integration notes (attached: redwood-sdk-integration-notes.md) — Marissa (TODAY)
2) Acme: send sample dataset (1000 queries + expected labels) for initial rerank eval — Alex / Priya (by 2026-03-20)
3) Tech deep-dive + PoC scoping (1-hour) — propose Wed 3/18 or Thu 3/19 — please confirm
4) Budget / procurement check: Alex to confirm whether Dedicated capacity procurement is an option for Q2

If I missed anything, reply-all and I’ll update. I’ve looped Dev (solutions engineer) and Rishi (platform lead) for technical scoping.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sdk-integration-notes.md (integration checklist + code samples)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Mehta <priya.mehta@acme.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-15T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & SDK requirements

Marissa — really helpful summary, thanks. A few clarifications from our side: 

- The latency spikes are most visible during catalog refresh windows (~10–15 min bursts). Our primary concern is 95th/99th percentile latency under burst.
- For reranking, the sample dataset we’ll send will include session context; could your team confirm if context length >512 tokens changes the recommended embedding dimension or rerank approach?
- Procurement: we’re stretched on calendar but Q2 spend is plausible. I’ll check with procurement and loop in finance if Dedicated is needed.

We can do Wed 3/18 10:00am PT for the tech deep-dive. Priya and I will attend; I’ve asked our infra lead to join if available.

Also: estimated unit cost is important for our eval — can your team provide a ballpark for the PoC (2M tokens/month, streaming + reranking calls) and an estimate for Dedicated baseline (reserved GPU pool)?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Johnson
Product Manager, ACME Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 (617) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & SDK requirements

Alex — great, confirmed: Wed 3/18 10:00am PT for the tech deep-dive. I’ll send a calendar invite with a short agenda.

Quick answers to questions you raised:
- Context length: our embedding recommendations change slightly past 512 tokens — for long session context we recommend 256–512d embeddings and chunking + context-aware reranking. I’ll have Dev bring a short note and sample config to the call.
- Ballpark cost: for PoC traffic profile (2M tokens/month with streaming + rerank) expect ~$1,200–1,800/month on hosted usage depending on prompt lengths; Dedicated baseline (reserved GPU pool) starts around $12k–$18k/month depending on instance sizing and SLA — we’ll provide a more precise estimate after we confirm expected concurrency and token distribution.

Attached is an initial mutual action plan (mutual-action-plan.xlsx) with milestones and ownership. Also linking the HubSpot record and a DocuSign placeholder for procurement: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/67890 | https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABCDEF123456

Next steps assigned:
- Marissa: calendar invite + agenda + attach PoC onboarding doc (today)
- Dev: bring sample SDK config for streaming + function-calling (3/18 deep-dive)
- Alex / Priya: share sample dataset (by 3/20)

Thanks — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Marissa
